title: Q-GAP-external-audit: An independent audit of prediction scoring
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:docs/audit/external-scoring-audit.json
**Status:** closed

Gap in component `metrics-triggers`: the prediction match rate is scored by the system itself. Have a party outside the system re-score a sample and record the result in docs/audit/external-scoring-audit.json.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 220.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
